_comment: Example only. Copy to config/slack-digest.json (git-ignored). See docs/slack-digest.md.
_keys: workspaceUrl: for message links. threadLookbackDays: how far back to look for threads with new replies. maxWindowHours/defaultWindowHours: window cap and first-run window. maxInputTokens: per-run cap. runDeadlineMinutes: the run gives up after this. unitOrder: unit order in the digest. customerGroup: the unit > sub-group whose conversations are customers (shown first, quiet ones named). myName: left out of group DM labels.
_models: primary is tried first; secondary once, only on timeout, 5xx, 429 or a provider mismatch. providers are OpenRouter provider slugs, pinned with no fallbacks and data_collection deny. temperature: whether the pinned endpoint accepts it. reasoningMandatory: the model cannot turn reasoning off (reasoningOff is then its lowest level). reasoningAllowance: extra max_tokens for reasoning. noCloud: conversation IDs never sent to any model.
